data.gender_notes: Selvam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who possesses the grace of God and is the owner of his own self. It is a respectful title given to God and to elders. The name Selvam carries the meaning “God's Grace, Owner of Self” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Selvam usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, owner of self and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine presence within and the grace of God.
data.etymology: Selvam belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace, Owner of Self.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Selvam total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Selvam" has its roots in the Tamil language of Hindu culture. This name is significant as it is a title commonly used to refer to both God and elders in the community out of respect. The word "Selvam" is derived from the Tamil word "Selvam," meaning " protector, self, or God." Its usage is a reminder of the importance placed on respecting the divine and cultural traditions within the Tamil Hindu community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Selvam" holds spiritual significance as it relates to an individual being the protector and owner of their own self, symbolizing the importance of self-discipline and self-realization in Hindu spirituality. Additionally, as a divine title, it emphasizes the connection between the individual and God, underscoring the belief that God is within an individual, guiding and protecting them. This name serves as a reminder of the ultimate goal in Hindu spirituality, which is to attain self-realization and union with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Selvam in Tamil means 'self' or 'own self'. It symbolizes the inner purity and the divine self, which exists within every being, reminding us to connect with and honor our inner wisdom and truth.
